status: organic pilot; no paid ads activated

campaigns.audience: Families looking for youth recreational soccer
campaigns.primaryAction: Open a suitable club profile, then contact the organizer
campaigns.message: Compare age groups, full cost and the weekly schedule before registering.

campaigns.audience: Adult players looking for a club
campaigns.primaryAction: Find a local team profile and check recruitment directly
campaigns.message: Search your area and level; league membership does not mean an open roster spot.

campaigns.audience: People looking for soccer venues in the currently covered areas
campaigns.primaryAction: Open a venue profile and check access
campaigns.message: Explore the places directory. Venue profiles are separate from organized pickup sessions.

measurement.source: Framer native aggregate analytics and Meta insights when authorized
measurement.minimumEvidence: Inspect real tagged visits, profile visits, clicks and submissions. Low samples or missing permissions are not proof a campaign won.
measurement.privacy: No new advertising pixel, cookies, contact exports or external tracker.

prerequisites: A functioning location-specific landing view with sufficient relevant results
